requirement.original: Send button triggers microphone permission dialog when input is empty. No visual distinction between send/voice modes. Expected: button should visually change to indicate voice mode, or at minimum not trigger browser mic permission without user intent.
requirement.clarified: Disable voice mode on web platform entirely: do not trigger mic permission and do not show microphone icon on the send button when input is empty.
requirement.what: Disable voice/mic functionality on web platform send button
requirement.why: Web microphone permission dialogs are unexpected and intrusive; web voice UX is poor

included: Hide microphone icon on web platform

success_criteria: No microphone permission dialog on web when pressing send with empty input
Send button shows disabled arrow-up icon on web with empty input
Native platforms retain full voice mode functionality
constraints: Web is a secondary platform per CLAUDE.md guidelines
Must not break native voice mode

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Pressing send button with empty input on web triggers browser microphone permission dialog
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: handleSendPress at line 477-480 unconditionally calls props.onMicPress() when !hasText, regardless of platform. The microphone icon renders at lines 1128-1136 when onMicPress is provided, also without platform guard.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - original implementation did not distinguish web from native for voice mode
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Voice mode was designed for native mobile first; web was treated identically
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Web browsers show intrusive permission dialogs for mic access; users don't expect voice input from a web app send button
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Since AgentInput voice mode was added

context.codebase_state: AgentInput.tsx at 1201 lines. Voice integration via onMicPress prop.
context.recent_commits: No recent changes to AgentInput voice logic

file_contents.AgentInput.tsx:307-309: canPressSendButton references onMicPress without platform check

development_approach.strategy: Add Platform.OS !== 'web' guard to three locations: (1) canPressSendButton computation, (2) handleSendPress mic call, (3) microphone icon rendering. On web with empty input, button shows disabled arrow-up.
development_approach.validation_approach: Build web app, verify send button with empty input does not trigger mic permission dialog and shows arrow-up icon. Test on native that voice mode still works.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward platform guard fix with clear locations identified
